title: One managed service, the platform that fits you
intro: Zyberworks is a technology partner with both CrowdStrike and SentinelOne, two of the world's leading endpoint security platforms. We assess your environment and deploy whichever fits, then wrap the same managed detection and response service around it: one lightweight agent covering endpoint, identity and cloud, with a 24/7 team stopping threats before they spread. You get enterprise grade protection without building a security operations centre of your own.

pillars.title: Endpoint protection & EDR
pillars.desc: AI native prevention and detection across every endpoint, tuned to your environment instead of left on noisy defaults.
points: Next generation antivirus that deploys in minutes
Endpoint and extended detection and response (EDR and XDR)
Device, firewall and USB control from a single policy
Coverage for Windows, macOS, Linux and mobile

pillars.title: Managed detection & response
pillars.desc: An expert team watching your environment around the clock so you never have to.
points: 24/7 expert led, AI accelerated detection and response
Threats contained in your environment, not just alerted on
A documented response and escalation path
Clear reporting your board and insurer can rely on

pillars.title: Threat intelligence & hunting

points: Proactive managed threat hunting, not just automated alerting
Coverage across endpoint, identity and cloud
World class threat intelligence built in
Findings turned into hardening you can act on
